scope: Six purposively selected historical positive cases for auditing investigative methods. No allegation about any current Indian actor is generated by analogy.
outcomePolicy: Legal outcomes are bounded to the dated, named proceeding. This is not a complete current docket-status service.
benchmarkStatus: Research/design only; no blind trial, empirical accuracy estimate or Indian transaction analysis has been executed on this benchmark.

sources.title: Select Committee on Presidential Campaign Activities
supports: Arrest-to-inquiry chronology; witness testimony prompted requests for recordings.
limitations: Retrospective institutional history, not the trial record; publication date not displayed.
sources.accessNotes: Full historical narrative read, Origins through Outcome.

cases.title: Watergate: the adjudicated cover-up and actor-specific limits
cases.mechanism: Campaign-linked covert activity followed by coordinated obstruction; the benchmark concerns the adjudicated cover-up, not every Watergate allegation.

discoveryPathway.known: Arrests at the break-in led to investigation and reporting; testimony about recordings enabled a corroboration route.
discoveryPathway.unknown: This compact review does not reproduce the complete campaign-money trail.

evidentiaryChain.evidence: The Senate history describes arrests, reporting and subsequent witness testimony.
evidentiaryChain.inferenceAllowed: Open an inquiry with rival accounts.
evidentiaryChain.inferenceNotAllowed: Public suspicion proves the president or every campaign employee guilty.

evidentiaryChain.evidence: The appellate opinion identifies testimony and tapes; its Count 9 discussion connects testimony, recordings and contemporaneous notes.
evidentiaryChain.inferenceAllowed: Compare accounts against independently created records.
evidentiaryChain.inferenceNotAllowed: A catalogue abstract substitutes for listening to an authenticated recording.
evidentiaryChain.locator: Opinion factual introduction and Count 9; catalogue provenance

evidentiaryChain.evidence: The majority affirmed Mitchell, Haldeman and Ehrlichman; the same introductory record reports Parkinson’s acquittal.
evidentiaryChain.inferenceAllowed: Attach disposition to the named defendant and count.
evidentiaryChain.inferenceNotAllowed: All co-defendants, people mentioned on tapes, or Nixon received these convictions.

legalOutcome.subject: John N. Mitchell; H. R. Haldeman; John D. Ehrlichman
legalOutcome.finding: Conspiracy, obstruction and submitted individual perjury convictions affirmed.
limits: Parkinson was acquitted; do not propagate co-defendant guilt.
The separate Mardian appeal is outside this reviewed record.
This outcome is not a criminal conviction of Richard Nixon.

transferableTests.question: Does a dated instruction corroborate a specific coordinated obstruction act?
transferableTests.comparator: Other participants and ordinary legal-response communications in the same period.
transferableTests.rivalExplanation: Lawful defence preparation or misunderstood recollection.
transferableTests.falsifier: Complete record contradicts the claimed instruction, actor identity or execution.
transferableTests.stopRule: Without act-specific corroboration, retain an attributed allegation.

transferableTests.question: Does each claimed participant have an individual evidence chain?
transferableTests.comparator: Acquitted and dismissed defendants, retained without relabelling.
transferableTests.rivalExplanation: Shared employment or presence without agreement.
transferableTests.falsifier: Evidence supports only association; a disposition excludes the claimed finding.
transferableTests.stopRule: Never inherit a conviction across an organizational edge.

nonTransferableInferences: A political party, administration or security institution elsewhere is not implicated by structural resemblance.
Secrecy, donor access, a tape catalogue entry or a public denial alone does not establish obstruction.

cases.title: Siemens: control circumvention and exact corporate pleas
cases.mechanism: Corrupt payments concealed through intermediary arrangements and inaccurate accounting, admitted within defendant-specific pleas.

discoveryPathway.known: DOJ describes Munich prosecutor searches preceding disclosure and a cooperating internal investigation.
discoveryPathway.unknown: The original lead that caused the searches is not established in this source set.

evidentiaryChain.evidence: Searches, internal review and cross-border cooperation generated evidence.
evidentiaryChain.inferenceAllowed: Identify records obtainable through lawful requests.
evidentiaryChain.inferenceNotAllowed: Public OSINT has the same access as compelled or cooperating investigators.

evidentiaryChain.evidence: The statement describes baseless consulting agreements, false invoices and controls bypass; it separately labels some payments’ purpose unknown.
evidentiaryChain.inferenceAllowed: Test services, approvals and payment destination jointly.
evidentiaryChain.inferenceNotAllowed: Classify every unexplained payment as a proven bribe.

evidentiaryChain.evidence: Parent and subsidiaries entered different pleas; civil disgorgement was separate.
evidentiaryChain.inferenceNotAllowed: Assign a subsidiary anti-bribery plea to the parent’s criminal counts.

legalOutcome.subject: Siemens AG; Siemens S.A. (Argentina); Siemens Bangladesh Ltd.; Siemens S.A. (Venezuela)
legalOutcome.finding: AG: internal-controls and books-and-records counts. Argentina: books-and-records conspiracy. Bangladesh and Venezuela: anti-bribery and books-and-records conspiracies.
limits: The parent’s criminal plea was not an anti-bribery-count plea.
SEC civil resolution and foreign penalties are separate procedural outcomes.

transferableTests.question: Is an intermediary payment supported by actual, appropriately priced work?
transferableTests.comparator: Comparable legitimate intermediaries, including unsuccessful bids.
transferableTests.rivalExplanation: Real consulting work or deficient documentation without corrupt purpose.
transferableTests.falsifier: Independently verified deliverables and market-consistent compensation defeat the specified sham-service claim.
transferableTests.stopRule: An invoice anomaly alone remains an accounting question.

transferableTests.question: Can each proposed corrupt-payment amount be independently classified?
transferableTests.comparator: Complete payment population with unknowns and reversals retained.
transferableTests.rivalExplanation: Unresolved purpose or legitimate transaction omitted from source material.
transferableTests.falsifier: Claimed total mixes proven, alleged and unknown payments or duplicates legs.
transferableTests.stopRule: Publish separate subtotals; do not impute missing purpose.

nonTransferableInferences: Using a consultant, making foreign payments or sharing an industry does not establish bribery by any Indian company or official.
A compliance weakness does not identify a bribe recipient or prove corrupt intent.

cases.title: Odebrecht: company-admitted coordination across intermediaries
cases.mechanism: An internal payment organization coordinated concealed transfers for foreign bribery.

discoveryPathway.known: The plea records no voluntary self-disclosure and later forensic collection, foreign document production and personnel cooperation.
discoveryPathway.unknown: The original investigative trigger and complete Brazilian discovery history were not established by the inspected sections.

evidentiaryChain.evidence: The agreement describes multinational forensic and documentary cooperation.
evidentiaryChain.inferenceAllowed: Distinguish acquired records from a hypothetical public graph.
evidentiaryChain.inferenceNotAllowed: Assume public corporate registries alone exposed every payment.

evidentiaryChain.evidence: Attachment B links company direction to named intermediary accounts; the release describes separate payment budgets and communication systems.
evidentiaryChain.inferenceAllowed: Require specific operational-control and transfer links.
evidentiaryChain.inferenceNotAllowed: Treat offshore incorporation or encryption alone as criminal.
evidentiaryChain.locator: Attachment B paragraphs 2, 4–6; release Bribery Schemes

evidentiaryChain.evidence: Odebrecht stipulated to facts and pleaded guilty to an FCPA anti-bribery conspiracy.
evidentiaryChain.inferenceNotAllowed: Treat this as an adjudication of every recipient’s liability.

legalOutcome.subject: Odebrecht S.A.
legalOutcome.finding: One count of conspiracy to violate the FCPA anti-bribery provisions.
limits: Braskem’s plea is a separate corporate outcome.
The announcement’s combined global penalty and ability-to-pay terms are not a receipt for a final paid amount.
No blanket inference about every politician, project or later proceeding.

transferableTests.question: Who directed the intermediary and the specific disbursement?
transferableTests.comparator: Disclosed affiliates and ordinary treasury/intermediary arrangements.
transferableTests.rivalExplanation: Lawful group treasury or outsourced payment administration.
transferableTests.falsifier: Independent control evidence or legitimate transaction purpose defeats the asserted controlled-payment chain.
transferableTests.stopRule: An offshore entity with no proved control/transfer link remains an unjoined lead.

transferableTests.question: Does a coded ledger entry resolve to an actor without circular inference?
requiredRecords: Independent identity key or corroborating record
transferableTests.comparator: Ambiguous and nonmatching identifiers, kept in review set.
transferableTests.rivalExplanation: Duplicate initials, accounting labels or multiple possible recipients.
transferableTests.falsifier: The candidate key fails on held-out entries or maps to multiple distinct people.
transferableTests.stopRule: No identity merge from a guessed code name.

nonTransferableInferences: A similar procurement pattern does not establish a concealed payment unit in India.
Shared secrecy tools, offshore jurisdictions or campaign relationships are not payment or agreement evidence.

cases.title: 1MDB: Roger Ng’s adjudicated role and traced transactions
cases.mechanism: Bond-financing proceeds diverted through a bribery and laundering scheme with accounting-control circumvention.

discoveryPathway.known: Public civil asset-tracing allegations appeared in 2016; the later criminal case presented records and witnesses to a jury.
discoveryPathway.unknown: These sources do not identify the first investigative tip or allow reconstruction of every transaction.

evidentiaryChain.evidence: The 2016 release describes civil forfeiture complaints alleging cross-border diversion.
evidentiaryChain.inferenceAllowed: Use a dated allegation as an acquisition lead.
evidentiaryChain.inferenceNotAllowed: Treat the complaint as a conviction of all referenced parties.

evidentiaryChain.evidence: DOJ reports testimony, email, phone, bank, travel and purchase records; bank evidence linked proceeds to an offshore company account in a relative’s name.
evidentiaryChain.inferenceAllowed: Demand transaction-specific corroboration of control and benefit.
evidentiaryChain.inferenceNotAllowed: Infer money laundering from kinship, luxury spending or offshore status alone.

evidentiaryChain.evidence: The sentencing account describes compliance evasion and deleted email accounts, alongside the sentence.
evidentiaryChain.inferenceAllowed: Evaluate concealment with the underlying transactions.
evidentiaryChain.inferenceNotAllowed: Every deletion or private email proves the same offence.

legalOutcome.subject: Ng Chong Hwa, also known as Roger Ng
legalOutcome.finding: Ten-year sentence after the 2022 jury verdict on laundering, FCPA bribery and accounting-control-circumvention conspiracies.
limits: Goldman Sachs parent’s 2020 DPA was not a guilty plea; GS Malaysia separately pleaded guilty.
Civil asset allegations and other individuals’ outcomes remain separate.
Historical stage; no assertion of fully checked later appellate status.

transferableTests.question: Can the alleged diverted amount be followed through every claimed leg?
transferableTests.comparator: Ordinary bond proceeds and legitimate disbursements within the same funding program.
transferableTests.rivalExplanation: Authorized investment, loan repayment, fees or unrelated money in a commingled account.
transferableTests.falsifier: The path breaks, amount is duplicated or legitimate source explains the specific asset.
transferableTests.stopRule: Do not infer a missing leg from matching rounded amounts or proximity in time.

transferableTests.question: Does evidence distinguish an error from knowing control circumvention?
transferableTests.comparator: Compliant deals and documented innocent corrections.
transferableTests.rivalExplanation: Misunderstood compliance request, record retention policy or clerical failure.
transferableTests.falsifier: Complete contemporaneous record supports disclosed, authorized conduct rather than the proposed deception.
transferableTests.stopRule: Keep negligence and knowing agreement as separate hypotheses.

nonTransferableInferences: A sovereign or welfare fund’s existence and a foreign bank connection do not imply an Indian analogue of 1MDB.
Association with an accused intermediary does not establish receipt, control, knowledge or guilt.

cases.title: Volkswagen: experimental anomaly, intent evidence and corporate conviction
cases.mechanism: Software distinguished testing from ordinary use, while corporate conduct concealed noncompliance.

discoveryPathway.known: The EPA notice records university road-test anomalies, recall retesting, failed technical explanations and a reported admission.
discoveryPathway.unknown: This benchmark did not rerun measurements or inspect software source code.

evidentiaryChain.evidence: Independent in-use measurements triggered regulatory inquiry.
evidentiaryChain.inferenceAllowed: Replicate under controlled and real-use conditions.
evidentiaryChain.inferenceNotAllowed: A road/lab discrepancy alone proves intentional cheating.

evidentiaryChain.evidence: Regulators retested after recall and investigated technical explanations before the reported admission.
evidentiaryChain.inferenceAllowed: Compare predictions of defect, operating conditions and deliberate test recognition.
evidentiaryChain.inferenceNotAllowed: Assume every noncompliant device is fraudulent; OIG explicitly distinguishes these.

evidentiaryChain.evidence: The DOJ sentencing account records three Volkswagen AG felony counts.
evidentiaryChain.inferenceAllowed: Anchor the criminal outcome to that company and proceeding.
evidentiaryChain.inferenceNotAllowed: Collapse civil settlements or other entities’ cases into this conviction.

legalOutcome.subject: Volkswagen AG
legalOutcome.finding: Three felony counts: conspiracy involving U.S. fraud, wire fraud and Clean Air Act violations; obstruction; false-statement importation. Plea entered March 10, 2017.
limits: No blanket finding about all employees or all brands/models.
Anomaly detection and the later criminal finding have different evidentiary thresholds.

transferableTests.question: Does measured performance change specifically when an audit is recognizable?
transferableTests.comparator: Matched units under ordinary and audited conditions, including compliant units.
transferableTests.rivalExplanation: Temperature, load, age, measurement error or legitimate protective behaviour.
transferableTests.falsifier: Difference disappears with controlled conditions or occurs equally in relevant controls.
transferableTests.stopRule: Report anomaly only until intentional manipulation has independent support.

transferableTests.question: Does a declared remedy fix the claimed mechanism on independent retesting?
transferableTests.comparator: Untreated comparable units and alternative measurement methods.
transferableTests.rivalExplanation: Regression to the mean, sample selection or unrelated maintenance.
transferableTests.falsifier: No reproducible effect, or the original anomaly fails replication.
transferableTests.stopRule: An unsuccessful remedy alone cannot establish a conspiracy.

nonTransferableInferences: A mismatch in welfare totals or audit metrics does not prove Indian officials intentionally manipulated them.
Regulatory noncompliance, poor design and coordinated fraud must not be merged.

cases.title: Glencore Energy UK: bribery, oil access and limits on individual findings
cases.mechanism: Corrupt payments supported preferential oil access, including sham service documentation.

discoveryPathway.known: SFO’s timeline dates the investigation announcement to 2019; judicial remarks describe later internal review, document production and admissions.
discoveryPathway.unknown: The original tip is not identified in the inspected sources.

evidentiaryChain.evidence: The court describes corporate cooperation and formal factual admissions.
evidentiaryChain.inferenceAllowed: Separate documentary corroboration from admitted facts.
evidentiaryChain.inferenceNotAllowed: Represent all evidence as publicly recovered transactions.

evidentiaryChain.evidence: The remarks connect sham service addenda and payment descriptions with oil-allocation arrangements.
evidentiaryChain.inferenceAllowed: Require a specific payment-purpose and decision link.
evidentiaryChain.inferenceNotAllowed: An oil contract, agent fee or pricing difference alone proves bribery.

evidentiaryChain.evidence: Corporate guilty pleas covered five bribery and two failure-to-prevent counts; the court excluded findings about specific individuals.
evidentiaryChain.inferenceNotAllowed: Transfer corporate culpability to every employee or related company.

legalOutcome.subject: Glencore Energy UK Ltd
legalOutcome.finding: Sentenced after pleas to five Bribery Act section 1 offences and two section 7 failure-to-prevent offences.
limits: The judge did not determine specific individuals’ culpability.
Other Glencore entities and jurisdictions have separate proceedings.
Commercial counterparty bribery and public-official bribery require distinct descriptions.
Original pleas were entered 21 June 2022; amended count 5 received a further plea on 31 October 2022.

transferableTests.question: Does a claimed commodity-price advantage reconcile with service charges and allocation decisions?
requiredRecords: Cargo-level quality, freight and price terms
transferableTests.comparator: Comparable grade, location, delivery date, risk and contract duration.
transferableTests.rivalExplanation: Quality discount, freight, timing, credit exposure or real services.
transferableTests.falsifier: Market and service adjustments explain the claimed discrepancy without the proposed improper payment.
transferableTests.stopRule: No bribery label from unexplained commodity spreads alone.

transferableTests.question: Which duty, act and responsible entity does each outcome establish?
transferableTests.comparator: Corporate failure-to-prevent counts versus individual participation claims.
transferableTests.rivalExplanation: Control failure without proof of the particular person’s agreement.
transferableTests.falsifier: The cited finding expressly excludes the asserted person or conduct.
transferableTests.stopRule: Preserve court-imposed scope limits in every graph edge and summary.

nonTransferableInferences: Foreign oil trading or resource allocation elsewhere is not evidence of wrongdoing by Indian actors.
A corporate conviction, shared employee or overlapping project cannot supply an absent individual intent link.

relationAudit.rule: Keep identity, ownership, authority, communication, transfer, benefit, allegation and adjudication separate. Co-mention never supplies another edge type.
Resolve legal entities with identifiers and dated records. Store ambiguous candidates without merging; distinguish controller, account holder and beneficiary.
Each transfer requires direction, date, currency, amount, stage, source and purpose status. Never sum commitments, disbursements, onward legs, recoveries and penalties as one flow.
A release, complaint, judgment and news report may share evidence. Group derivations by sourceFamily and inspect the underlying record; document count is not independent corroboration count.
Every consequential edge needs source ID, exact locator, access depth, supported proposition and explicit exclusions; inaccessible evidence stays an acquisition task.
Record event date, document creation, public availability, retrieval and amendment separately. A forward test may only use material available before its frozen cutoff.
Separate alleged rule breach, admitted conduct, administrative finding, settlement, DPA, plea, jury verdict, appeal, acquittal and dismissal; name defendant, count and jurisdiction.
Before selecting confirming examples, specify a lawful rival, its differing observation, a comparison population, a falsifier and a stop condition.
Unknown purpose, unavailable records and non-response are not positive evidence of concealment without separate support for selective destruction or withholding.
Historical cases may suggest a test or record request. They provide zero actor-specific evidentiary support for a new allegation.

evaluationDesign.unit: A bounded proposition or typed relation at a frozen information cutoff, not a whole person or administration.
evaluationDesign.selectionLimit: Known positive cases cannot estimate prevalence, false-positive rate or probability of conspiracy. Acquittal means the charge was not proved, not that every factual allegation is false.
proposedProtocol: Create independent case packets with dates, document hashes, source-family derivation and legal labels. Freeze before model access; keep later evidence and outcome keys hidden.
Add predeclared lawful, unresolved, acquitted/dismissed and misleading-association controls matched on sector and observable complexity. Keep these labels distinct rather than calling all negative.
Randomize packets and anonymize where practical, while acknowledging famous-case recognition and model pretraining leakage. Use unseen forward-dated material for a true prospective test.
Require the same output for every packet: claim, typed links, missing links, rival prediction, falsifier, lawful acquisition step, outcome scope and abstention where warranted.

Evaluate source entailment, identity accuracy, legal-stage accuracy, contradicted-claim withdrawal and precision of asserted relations. Separately assess whether requested records would discriminate hypotheses.
Use two independent reviewers with adjudication of disagreement; do not treat multiple AI opinions as independent documentary evidence.
Report denominators, coverage, unresolvable items and errors by evidence stage; prohibit probability-of-guilt scores unless a separately validated calibration study supports that use.
evaluationDesign.gameTheoryLimit: Model incentives to generate competing observable predictions. Shared incentives, a plausible payoff or a fitted story after seeing the outcome cannot prove communication, agreement, intent or illegality.
